text:
jess: Quick thread  compact welcome + dormant-trigger plan for April launch. Goals: 1) convert 8% of new signups to trial in first 14 days, 2) re-engage 15% of dormant list (180+ days). Keep it minimal - mobile-first.

luke: structure idea: two-path flow. New signups = 3-email newbie spiral (welcome -> quick tips -> soft CTA). Dormant = 3-email rewarm (subject hook -> value snippet -> promo/testimonial).

priya: segmentation: new_signups = signed_up <= 14d; dormant = last_open >= 180d. Exclusions: unsubscribed, customers, trial-active. Add subsegment for enterprise candidates (company_size > 500).

jess: creative: short subject lines, 1-line preheader, single-CTA button. Variation: promo vs no-promo for dormant (test).

theo: UTMs and headers: utm_campaign=compact_apr_launch, utm_source=email, utm_medium=newsletter, utm_content={path}_{variant}. add header X-Campaign=compact-apr.

priya: cadence proposal:
Day 0: welcome (new) / reintro (dormant)
Day 4: tips + use-case highlight
Day 10: stronger CTA + social proof or promo (only for dormant promo variant)

luke: A/B test subjects for new signups: A) "Welcome — quick start in 2 mins" B) "Start with a template: Launch in minutes". Measure opens and trial starts.

jess: metrics to track: delivered->open->click->trial_start->paid_convert (for cohort). Targets: open 35% new / 22% dormant; trial_start 8% new / 3% dormant.

theo: ops notes: create seed list, test render across clients, and run warm-up for dormant batch (start 5% then ramp). Also add throttle by domain.

priya: automation triggers: new signups enter flow immediately; if trial_start happens, remove from flow and send onboarding drip from product. Dormant: if opens or clicks, escalate to nurture and tag as reactivated.

luke: creative asks: 2 subject lines, 2 preheaders, 2 hero images (mobile & desktop), short testimonial quote. who owns what?

jess: priya owns segments & flow, luke owns copy & images, theo owns UTMs and ops. I'll review copy.

deliver-bot: Reminder: finalize assets 48h before first send window.

jess: timeline: assets by Thu EOD, seed test Fri, send next Tue. If we hit targets, scale promo to 25% of dormant cohort.

priya: posting segment exports to #marketing-seg in 10m. ping for QA.

luke: I'll drop subject + preheaders in this thread by EOD.

jess: nice work. short, measurable, and quick to iterate.
